Minor release: the Telegram assistant gains per-session model selection and a registered command menu; the dashboard's ACWR gauge is rebuilt on correct geometry. Includes #6, #7, #8, #9.

## Features

### /model — per-session Claude model selection (#7)
- New `/model` fast path: inline keyboard with Default (config) / Sonnet 4.6 / Haiku 4.5 / Opus 5
- Selection lives in a per-process session dict (same lifetime as `pending`/`history`); resets to `CLAUDE_MODEL` on bot restart
- `llm.chat()` gains a keyword-only `model=` override; precedence: session pick → `CLAUDE_MODEL` → default
- `model:<key>` callbacks never touch pending Confirm/Cancel proposals

### Telegram "/" command menu (#8)
- `run()` registers `/help`, `/model`, `/today`, `/balance` via `setMyCommands` at startup — the menu stays in sync with the code, no BotFather step needed
- Registration failure is non-fatal (transient retry, logged) so it can never block the long-poll loop

## Fixes

### Dashboard arc geometry (#6)
- ACWR gauge band arcs are now generated from the `db.ACWR_*` thresholds via shared polar helpers — every arc on one r=80 circle with exact junctions. Previously the hand-coded breakpoints sat off-circle (82.4/84.4px from center) and encoded ratios 0.60/1.40/1.60 instead of the real 0.8/1.3/1.5, so the needle could disagree with the band pill
- Sleep-stages doughnut seams removed (`borderWidth: 0` + `spacing: 2` instead of an off-palette border color)
- `animateRings()`: no more rewind flash on HTMX re-swaps; empty rings no longer render a floating linecap dot
- Readiness ring pct clamped in Python (matching macro rings)
- Moved an inline comment out of an f-string expression — that syntax needs Python 3.12+ (PEP 701), so `src/dashboard.py` previously failed to import on the documented 3.11 baseline

### CI
- Claude PR review action runs on pull requests (#5)

### Documentation & housekeeping
- CLAUDE.md synced with current code; BLE-era `setup.sh` leftovers removed
- `__version__` bumped to 1.1.0 and stale BLE-era package description replaced (#9)

## Tests
- 20 new tests: SVG geometry invariants (`tests/test_dashboard_svg.py` — first render-layer coverage), the `/model` flow end-to-end, and command-menu registration
- Full suite: 209 passing
